integrity: The all-iteration statement is proved algebraically. The bundled exact-rational replay is a finite consistency check and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-QP, constant-step analysis of one unit-disk witness; not a universal theorem for other constraints, variable steps, inexact QP solves, or the full primal-QP class.
title: Persistent half-step infeasibility coexists with averaged feasibility in the OPCGM disk witness
